user.title: Connect GetMyMeter
user.description: Enter the read-only portal values. The token is sensitive, is stored in the config entry, and is never placed in a request URL.

data_description.company_id: The company or utility identifier shown in your own portal request.
data_description.account: The account identifier shown in your own portal request; do not paste a username or password.
data_description.channel: The meter channel shown in your own portal request.
data_description.token: The h2o-token request header from an /ami_data request. Do not use the H2O-Portal-Token page value or h2o-portal-token cookie. Never save, log, screenshot, upload, or share it.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate GetMyMeter
reauth_confirm.description: The portal token has expired. Enter a replacement token from your authenticated portal session.

data_description.token: Paste the h2o-token request header from an /ami_data request only; never include the portal page token, cookies, or a copied request.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GetMyMeter
reconfigure.description: Change the read-only portal identity. Enter a current token to validate the new values.

data_description.company_id: The company or utility identifier shown in your own portal request.
data_description.account: The account identifier shown in your own portal request.
data_description.channel: The meter channel shown in your own portal request.
data_description.token: The current h2o-token request-header value; never include cookies or a copied request.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the GetMyMeter portal.
error.invalid_auth: The H2O portal token was rejected or expired.

abort.already_configured: This GetMyMeter meter channel is already configured.

reauth_required.message: The GetMyMeter portal token has expired or was rejected; reauthentication is required.
